data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme following Asian (excluding Japan) equity theme
data.investment_objective: The Scheme seeks to provide medium to long term appreciation through investments primarily in Asian Companies/sectors(excluding Japan) with long term potential across market capitalisation.
data.asset_allocation: Equities and Equity Linked instruments: 80% - 100% - Domestic securities: 35% - 45% - Foreign Securities@: 45% - 65% Domestic Debt securities and Money Market Instruments: 0% - 20% Units of Infrastructure Investment Trust (InvIT): 0%-10%
data.benchmark: 75% MSCI Asia (Ex-Japan) Standard Index + 25% Nifty 500 Index
data.fund_managers: Shyam Sundar Sriram, Sandeep Manam (Dedicated Foreign Fund Manager)
data.exit_load: In respect of each purchase of Units - 1% if the Units are redeemed/switched- out within one year from the date of allotment
